how_it_works_copy.mint: Purchase the ebook NFT for $15 USD; the mint number is the referral code.
how_it_works_copy.referrals: Sharing the mint number or link earns an instant $5 USD for each referred mint, with no limit or expiration; when no code is used, the commission and ticket go to a random existing ticket holder.
how_it_works_copy.tickets: Each successful referral gives one on-chain ticket for the current $500 draw, and more referrals provide more chances to win; tickets expire after their draw.
how_it_works_copy.prizes: One affiliate from each 100-sales block wins $500 through a fair Chainlink VRF draw.
how_it_works_copy.reward_collection: Commissions are sent automatically to the user's wallet, while a prize must be collected through the claim button that appears when it is claimable; prize results and notifications remain available through the Winners page, dashboard, and email when available.

decisions.reason: Manual prize collection does not alter fiat-wallet provisioning, eventual wallet asset custody, dashboard or SIWE access, or fiat cashout guidance.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY establishing manual collection through a claim button shown only when the prize is claimable.
The Mission page's unqualified statement that smart contracts provide automatic payouts became inaccurate once prize collection was confirmed as manual.

value_updates.transparency_copy: Everything happens on-chain, with smart contracts providing fair play and automatic commission payouts, while a prize winner collects the prize through the claim button shown when it is claimable.

decisions.reason: The prize collection method does not change ticket issuance, eligibility, weighting, expiration, transfer, or reset rules.
Winner-email delivery and fiat cashout guidance remain valid; the source does not necessarily change email contents or delivery behavior.
The hero content describes referral commissions and prize entry frequency but makes no assertion about how a winner collects a prize.
Confirming manual collection after a draw does not change winner eligibility, ticket weighting, Chainlink VRF, or the selection method.
The prize claim flow does not change Transak payment methods, fiat conversion, or NFT purchase fulfillment.
Prize collection has no effect on the landing-page cover's location, size, crop, overlap, or visibility requirements.
Manual prize collection does not alter the required accuracy of prize-pool values or next-draw progress counters.
The prize claim decision is unrelated to ebook rendering, reader entry points, or navigation controls.
